items.information: This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa3RsIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d783e6bc8ef9637fd7108a6fcfdc60829bd500da/image.png) We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Assocation ](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing)for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.
